metadata.description: Interview someone about how they really do their work and turn it into a Knowledge Pack: one zip with a browser walkthrough, their real screenshots or photos, and a file any AI can teach from. For new-hire manuals, stand-ins, team SOPs, know-how only one person has, and handovers.
